description: This file defines the LocationDecorator class, which adds additional functionality and behavior to the Location entity within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for setting related country data, retrieving the number of employees at a location, and managing associated services.

classes.name: LocationDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class for the Location entity providing additional methods such as setting a country by code and retrieving employee count at a location.

methods.name: setLocationService
methods.description: Assigns an external LocationService instance to the decorator.

methods.name: getLocationService
methods.description: Retrieves the LocationService instance, creating a new one if it doesn't exist.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs a LocationDecorator with a specific Location entity.

methods.name: setCountryByCountryCode
methods.description: Sets the country for the location based on a provided country code, using the CountryService.

methods.name: getNoOfEmployees
methods.description: Fetches and returns the number of employees for the current location.
